name: Welcome to Erosland
source:
A young guy in his late 20's lives in a futuristic world, working for something he doesn't like, drowning in his everyday routine… But one day, he receives an email from an unknown source. "You've inherit an archipelago and lots of money from your unknown grandfather." It isn't a fake.

He travels to the archipelago. A gorgeous woman welcomes him. 'You are now the owner of this place, Master...'

Eros will discover a mysterious high tech machine that will change his life even more.

Welcome To Erosland will let you create and manage a sex themed park with lots of different girls working in it.

[From [url=https://pixelgamesx.itch.io/welcome-to-erosland]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名二十多岁后半的年轻男子生活在未来世界，做着自己不喜欢的工作，日复一日地陷入例行生活……某天，他收到一封来自未知发件人的电子邮件：“你从素未谋面的祖父那里继承了一片群岛和大笔财产。”这竟然不是骗局。

他前往群岛。一位绝色美女迎接他：“主人……您现在就是这里的所有者了。”

Eros将发现一台神秘的高科技机器，它会进一步改变他的人生。

《Welcome to Erosland》让你创建并经营一座以性爱为主题的乐园，雇用形形色色的女孩。

[摘自[url=https://pixelgamesx.itch.io/welcome-to-erosland]Itch.io[/url]]
